charts.title: Win rate by age (Big 3, Sinner, Alcaraz)
charts.premise: ATP main-tour win percentage by integer age for Roger Federer, Rafael Nadal, Novak Djokovic, Jannik Sinner, and Carlos Alcaraz. Walkovers and defaults excluded; retirements count. Big 3 peak years before 2016 are outside this warehouse.

charts.title: Mean pre-match Elo by age
charts.premise: Average match_elo elo_pre by integer age for the same five ATP players on the main tour from 2016-10-01 onward; minimum five matches per age bin.

charts.title: Win rate vs top-10 opponents
charts.premise: In-window career win percentage against opponents ranked 1–10 at match time for the Big 3, Sinner, and Alcaraz; walkovers and defaults excluded.

charts.title: Retirements and walkovers by season
charts.premise: ATP and WTA main-tour counts of retired, walkover, and defaulted matches by calendar season; partial seasons flagged.

charts.title: Year-end top-20 match and minute load
charts.premise: Per season, total matches and minutes for players in the year-end top-20 snapshot (ATP and WTA separate series). Tour×seasons with no November-or-later ranked main-tour snapshot are omitted (e.g. incomplete 2026).

charts.title: Top-10 membership churn
charts.premise: Distinct players who held rank ≤10 during each season and count of in-window first-time top-10 appearances (not career debut).

charts.title: Year-end #1 vs #10 points gap
charts.premise: Gap between positional #1 and #10 rank_points from the November year-end snapshot rule; seasons with fewer than ten qualifiers skipped.

charts.title: Age at first in-window top-10 match
charts.premise: Age at first main-tour match with rank ≤10 on or after 2016-10-01; left-censored at window start — players already ≤10 at first window match are flagged, not treated as a career-debut cohort.

charts.title: Grand Slam champion path (mean opponent rank)
charts.premise: For each men's GS champion since 2017, mean loser rank of on-court matches won en route (final winner only); Alexander Zverev highlighted. Null opponent ranks dropped; early rounds dominate the mean.

charts.title: Distinct Grand Slam champions per year
charts.premise: Count of distinct singles champions (round = F) per calendar year, ATP vs WTA.

charts.title: Seeded-vs-seeded upset rate
charts.premise: Upset rate when both seeds are known, loser seed better than winner seed, completed matches only — retirements, walkovers, and defaults excluded.

charts.title: Ace rate heatmap (GS + Masters)
charts.premise: Ace rate by stable event_key and season for Grand Slams and Masters 1000; completed matches with complete stats and both sides svpt > 0.

charts.title: Hold rate heatmap (GS + Masters)
charts.premise: Hold rate by event_key and season using the locked hold-match filter; cells with fewer than 20 matches dropped.
